title: Freeze P1 product slice and implementation defaults
scope: P1: evidence-bound Evaluation Section Pipeline, with Paper Search as the technical foundation slice

decisions.decision: Split receipt semantics into completed_empty and unknown_outcome.
decisions.reversal_condition: A later evidence-backed contract review demonstrates that the distinction is not observable or useful without weakening fail-closed behavior.

decisions.decision: Pending recovery defaults to explicit failure closure; re-execution requires an explicit, separately authorized operation.
decisions.reversal_condition: A bounded recovery experiment proves safe re-execution with no duplicate durable facts or external side effects.

decisions.decision: Prefer a non-persisting search path so Evidence admission is the single durable evidence creation path; fall back to reconcile/reference only if feasibility evidence rejects the preferred path.
decisions.reversal_condition: Implementation evidence shows a non-persisting path cannot preserve required legacy behavior without unacceptable scope expansion.

decisions.decision: Treat run receipt ownership and capability invocation idempotency records as distinct facts: Runtime owns run receipt; Capability Adapter owns its invocation idempotency record through the Store idempotency API. R-004 L1 must be synchronized before S1 promotion.
decisions.reversal_condition: R-004 program review assigns both facts to a single owner or requires the idempotency write to move back into Runtime.

decisions.decision: The first user-visible product slice is one Evaluation Section Pipeline.
decisions.reversal_condition: Team review finds a smaller slice that proves the same trust and product-value claims with less risk.

decisions.decision: The first release supports one paper type and a finite, versioned WritingProfile.
decisions.reversal_condition: A second real consumer requires a broader profile and the added rules have an explicit owner and acceptance set.

decisions.decision: Benchmark Advisor v1 produces a plan, candidate baselines, metrics and material checklist; it does not claim experiment results or automatically execute unapproved experiments.
decisions.reversal_condition: A separately approved Experiment contract adds controlled execution.

decisions.decision: Missing critical materials block the stage; non-critical gaps return needs_material with an actionable checklist.
decisions.reversal_condition: A rule-specific risk analysis changes the blocking classification.

decisions.decision: Writing rules come from project configuration plus a versioned WritingProfile, not from an unversioned prompt or Skill alone.
decisions.reversal_condition: A future rule-source contract preserves versioning, reproducibility and auditability with a different source.

decisions.decision: Paper Search remains the technical foundation slice; the product acceptance target is the Evaluation Section Pipeline.
decisions.reversal_condition: P1 is re-scoped by a new approved product decision.

not_authorized: No blanket implementation of all paper-writing modules.
No S2 start before S1 promotion evidence.
No main-line integration until each worktree has authored its L3 contract, fixtures, acceptance and rollback note and the project owner has reviewed the handoff.
next_step: Create the P1 implementation package and have each task owner submit a task-local L3 contract for approval.
